if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
then: the tax invoice MUST carry the recipient's name, address and GSTIN or Unique Identity Number, where the recipient is registered
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(d), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: name, address and Goods and Services Tax Identification Number or Unique Identity Number, if registered, of the recipient;
